method: Coordinator fetched the published branch, checked out the exact commit in a separate recovery checkout on the same machine, observed a clean checkout and ran check_published_evidence_privacy.py.
qualification: The log does not embed the checkout commit ID. The coordinator separately observed HEAD before and after the successful command; the transcript hash proves only its bytes. This is same-machine recovery verification, not independent-machine attestation, source-audit completion, implementation or product validation. Public checks use explicitly qualified redacted reconstructions and do not purge previous Git history.
